list.auth: authenticated member; SQL member_id scope; normal current-source cookie/CSRF client

keyword.match: SQL LIKE %value% on title or label; not content; wildcard semantics backend-existing

has_code.disable: omit; 0 is not a no-code filter
has_code.match: editor_type != html AND content contains backend SQL fence/backtick heuristics

shared.match: share record exists/not exists; not equivalent to visibility

encrypted.match: password nonempty/empty; does not unlock content

editor_type.match: exact editor type; null coalesced markdown

response.data: array or null for empty; do not swallow malformed shape as empty

item.content_preview: string; protected empty; bounded client snippet

list.ordering: is_pinned DESC, pin_order ASC, modify_time DESC; no server sort query

singlePin.unknown: read actual state before any next explicit toggle; no automatic retry

singleVisibility.semantics: toggle 0/1; private cleanup shares, public autocreates share; confirmation and fresh state required

body.ids: deduplicated positive IDs from explicit selection snapshot only

bulkPin.semantics: sets is_pinned=1 only; owner-filtered; cannot unpin
bulkPin.reconciliation: reread selected IDs; ambiguous or failed IDs remain selected across pages; affected alone never proves every ID

trash.scope: one selected ID per request using existing resource trash contract; retain failed/unknown selection

labelsCompatibility.legacyRead: serialized JSON string array or plain comma-separated text only in explicit compatibility decoder; invalid array/mixed values => retained error, not silent empty
labelsCompatibility.write: existing resource-label endpoint uses JSON object with labels CSV string; do not send list to that field
labelsCompatibility.bulk: not an invented batch endpoint; out of this first filter/pin batch

capabilities.local: currently no is_pinned/visibility columns; do not show fake successful server-only filters/actions. Existing label/keyword stay; future date/code only after explicit local-query implementation+tests
capabilities.complex: article/all complex editor bodies open existing WebView; ordinary Markdown native

selection.scope: only explicitly selected IDs in same actual space/generation
selection.crossPage: preserve selected IDs and failures across loaded pages; show offscreen count
selection.filterChange: confirm before clearing selection and applying changed query; cancel preserves old filters/selection
selection.maintenance: space change retires pending reads/writes and cannot leak selection into another account
